notes.title: Patch Notes: Level 4 & 5 Fixes, Resource Balance & More!
notes.notes: [p]Hey Survivors! [/p][p][/p][p]A new patch has just gone live, packed with important fixes and improvements based on your valuable feedback. We've focused heavily on addressing critical issues across various maps, especially Level 4 and Level 5, as well as general quality-of-life updates. [/p][p][/p][p]Here are some of the most important highlights from this patch: Level 4 & 5 Progression Fixed: We've adjusted resource availability (especially Parts) on Levels 4 and 5, ensuring all paths for interacting with cannibals are now viable and you can progress smoothly.[/p][p][/p][p] Units resource consumption change: To prevent unnecessary losses, units will now instantly replenish food and water when near death.[/p][p][/p][p] Airport Map Overhaul: Expect significant improvements to the Airport map, including fixes for loading/saving issues and the addition of mutated deer as a new food source to balance resources. [/p][p]Production & Resource Reliability: We've addressed various production bugs in late-game buildings like the Metal Mine, Wood Factory, and Oil Pump, plus fixed the scrap collector not gathering Parts properly.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s what else is new and improved: [/p][p]General Fixes & Improvements Happiness System: Tweaked happiness calculations for houses. Fixed a bug affecting how house residents' happiness was calculated. [/p][p]Unit Behavior: Units will now instantly replenish food and water when near death to prevent unnecessary losses. [/p][p]Cemetery Mechanics: Skeletons will no longer be created on the ground when a Graveyard is built. [/p][p]Production Buildings: Addressed several production issues in later-game buildings, including the Metal Mine, Wood Factory, and Oil Pump, to ensure smoother resource generation. [/p][p]Language Settings: Fixed saving and loading of selected game language in the locale dropdown. Internal Development: Disabled save testing keys (not visible to players). Miscellaneous: Various other minor tweaks and bug fixes included.[/p][p][/p][p]Level 5 - Specific Fixes & Updates Core Functionality: Implemented a significant round of fixes for Level 5 issues. [/p][p]Save and Load Fixes: Improved stability for saving and loading on this map. Resource Collection: Parts Collection Fix: The scrap collector now correctly gathers "Parts" resources. Updated WorkSources list to reflect correct resource points. [/p][p]Map Navigation & Visuals: Navmesh (navigation mesh) has been updated for improved unit pathfinding. Updated colliders for better object interaction.[/p][p] Work Positions Alignment: Corrected work positions for resources to align properly with the updated navmesh and terrain height. Fixed the Electric Pump's build position and removed its "floating" appearance.[/p][p] Camera position and border changes. Gameplay & Balance: New Food Source: Added mutated deer to the map to improve food resource availability. Hunters now reliably find and work at available dead animal spots. High-tech access for Level 5 has been fixed.[/p][p][/p][p]Level 4 - Specific Fixes & Updates Core Functionality: Implemented a range of fixes for Level 4 issues. Save and Load Fixes: Improved stability for saving and loading on this map. [/p][p]Resource Collection: Parts Collection Fix: The scrap collector now correctly gathers "Parts" resources. Updated WorkSources list to reflect correct resource points. Fixed Oil Pump resource production on this map. [/p][p]Map Navigation & Visuals: Navmesh (navigation mesh) has been updated for improved unit pathfinding. Updated colliders for better object interaction. [/p][p]Work Positions Alignment: Corrected work positions for resources to align properly with the updated navmesh. Camera position and border changes.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support and for helping us make Post-Apo Builder even better![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes – Update Changelog
notes.notes:
Patch Notes – Update Changelog

Hey everyone!
Here’s a list of fixes and improvements included in the latest update. Thanks again for all your feedback and bug reports, it really helps!

🛠 Fixes & Improvements:

Fixed flickering in structure cost tooltips

Fixed tribal panel display issues

Fixed glossary background visuals and welcome panel lock

Fixed text formatting issue in tribal panel

Added tutorial quest step clarifying that players need to sign the “Goods from the Wasteland” decree to unlock the Trade Post (was blocking some players)

Added camera rotation key bindings in the options menu (to support alternate keyboard layouts like AZERTY)

Updated game control bindings

Fixed tutorial decree null error and issues with welcome/tutorial panels

Adjusted camera borders in Level 2 so newcomers at the gate are reachable

Pub building updated; improved bartender behavior and reworked GetNearestWaterSource logic for better stability

Fixed ultra-wide resolution (5120x1440) display issues in the decree panel

🔧 Save/Load Fixes:

Expedition data now loads correctly

Map construction state now restores properly

Unit resource visuals reset correctly on game start

Fixed null reference errors related to the tutorial during save/load

Various other minor tweaks and bug fixes included

As always, thank you for playing and sharing your feedback. More fixes and improvements are on the way!

See you in the Wasteland!
 The Post-Apo Builder Team

notes.title: Post-Apo Builder is finally available on Steam!
notes.notes:
This game is the result of many months of hard work, passion, and creativity powered by countless cups of coffee, sleepless nights, and more than a few stubborn bugs. We've poured our hearts into building a world that feels broken yet full of hope, harsh yet worth saving.

Every ruined building, every survivor, and every decision you make is part of a story we've been dying to share with you. This isn’t just about surviving the apocalypse it’s about rebuilding what was lost, finding meaning in the ruins, and maybe, just maybe, reconnecting what remains of humanity.

We’re incredibly proud (and honestly a bit nervous) to finally open the gates. Thank you to everyone who supported us  with wishlists, feedback, or even just curiosity. Now it’s your turn, Captain.

Take charge. Lead. And above all — survive.

notes.title: Post-Apo Builder Launching June 2nd!
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors,

We’re excited to announce that Post-Apo Builder will officially launch on June 2nd!
It’s been a long road, and we’ve worked hard to bring this post-apocalyptic world to life. We deeply appreciate everyone who added us to their wishlist, tried the Prologue, or gave us feedback along the way.

This is just the beginning and we’re fully committed to supporting and expanding the game after launch.

🛠️ Post-launch roadmap:
Right after release, we plan to roll out:

🌍 New levels/maps to expand your building challenges

⚙️ Upgrades for vehicles, buildings, and tech

🧠 QoL improvements: UI/UX polishing and balancing tweaks

🔧 Bugfixes and optimization based on yours feedback

We're building this world together and we want it to evolve with you.
Join the discussion, report bugs, or share your ideas on our Steam forums and Discord.

Thanks for your support we’ll see you on June 2nd!

The Post-Apo Builder Team
